# Spectra Pack Machines

> Spectra Pack Machines is an industrial packaging machinery manufacturer established in 2025 in Vasai, near Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. The team's prior packaging-industry experience dates to 2001. The head office is in Vasai West and the manufacturing facility in Vasai East, Palghar. The website covers machine selection, product trials, installation, support and quotations across India.

Start with the machine catalog to find equipment for a product and packaging format. Product pages describe the offered configurations; confirm application suitability, output, pricing, delivery, warranty and service scope with the company using the buyer's actual product and container. City pages describe supply and service planning, and do not imply a separate local factory or office.

## Company and enquiries

- [Home](https://spectrapackmachines.com/): Company overview and packaging solutions.
- [About](https://spectrapackmachines.com/about): Company background and manufacturing infrastructure.
- [Contact](https://spectrapackmachines.com/contact): Sales enquiries, contact details and office and factory addresses.
- [Schedule a meeting](https://spectrapackmachines.com/schedule-meeting): Discuss a machine application or packaging line requirement.

## Machines and categories

- [Machine catalog](https://spectrapackmachines.com/machines): Browse machines and compare packaging applications.
- [Shrink wrapping machines](https://spectrapackmachines.com/products/category/shrink-wrapping-machines): Shrink tunnels, L-sealers and bottle and carton wrapping systems.
- [Sealing machines](https://spectrapackmachines.com/products/category/sealing-machines): Pouch, bag and continuous sealing equipment.
- [Vacuum packaging machines](https://spectrapackmachines.com/products/category/vacuum-packaging-machines): Vacuum packing equipment and configurations.
- [Conveyor systems](https://spectrapackmachines.com/products/category/conveyors): Product transfer and packaging line conveyors.
- [Pallet stretch wrapping machines](https://spectrapackmachines.com/products/category/pallet-stretch-wrapping-machines): Pallet wrapping equipment for dispatch loads.
- [Carton taping and box strapping](https://spectrapackmachines.com/products/category/automatic-carton-taping-with-box-strapping): End-of-line carton closure and strapping equipment.

## Application and service buying guides

- [Packaging solutions](https://spectrapackmachines.com/solutions): Select equipment by the actual packaging process and prepare a quotation brief.
- [Pallet stretch wrapping](https://spectrapackmachines.com/solutions/pallet-stretch-wrapping): Small factory and warehouse loads, film trials, space and Pune or Delhi supply enquiries.
- [Shrink wrapping and sealing](https://spectrapackmachines.com/solutions/shrink-wrapping-sealing): Small-business pack formats, film, automation and supplier comparison.
- [Automatic liquid filling lines](https://spectrapackmachines.com/solutions/liquid-filling-lines): Water or juice bottle filling, capping, labelling, trials and line scope.
- [Conveyor systems](https://spectrapackmachines.com/solutions/conveyor-systems): Flat belt, modular, slat and roller conveyors for Maharashtra packaging lines.
- [Industrial vacuum packaging](https://spectrapackmachines.com/solutions/vacuum-packaging): Chamber and pouch selection, cycle trials and itemized Maharashtra quotations.
